_doc: Dated fact sheet for the CTVA retrospective (retro/build_ctva.py; retro/README.md, 'CTVA'). Corteva, Inc., listed on the NYSE from 2019-06-03. Every value cites a source with its 'published' date (EDGAR acceptance time in ET; after the 16:00 close a filing counts from the next trading day). Generated by script from the transcribed rows; growth rates, margins, tax rates and rule-T values are computed, not typed.

listing.note: Corteva, Inc. was distributed by DowDuPont on June 1, 2019; its own P/E exists only from the first regular-way trading day (the listing rule of method r2): 'Corteva, Inc.'s common stock began trading the "regular way" under the ticker symbol "CTVA" on June 3, 2019, the first business day after June 1, 2019' (FY2019 10-K). The when-issued days before it are not read

distributions.note: Yahoo books the 2026-10-01 distribution as a 6665:1000 split; it is not a split, so its factor is undone for the days before it and every close is the price as traded (the MAR, PFE, BMY and SO 'distributions' rule). It is a price-series encoding only: no fact of it enters a model, and no model is dated on or after it

rule_t._doc: Rule T values behind the thresholds of the engine (retro/templates/ctva_engine.py.tmpl; retro/README.md, 'CTVA'): the annual year-on-year changes reported by the filings public on 2021-02-05, the first date of the series, however few (the bounds rule of method r2), each from the latest filing published by then that reports both years, on the basis it reports them. Organic growth and price: the Q4 2019 release's twelve-month price-volume-currency analysis (FY2019 vs FY2018, as reported) and the Q4 2020 release's (FY2020 vs FY2019); the FY2019 10-K's 2018-vs-2017 analysis is on a pro forma basis and is not used. Gross margin (net sales less cost of goods sold) and the pre-tax margin (income from continuing operations before income taxes on net sales): the FY2019 10-K's statements of operations for 2019 and 2018, the Q4 2020 release's for 2020 and 2019, and for the pre-tax margin the FY2019 10-K's selected financial data for 2016 against 2015 (the predecessor's agriculture business, as published); 2017 is reported only as two periods, so no change into or out of it exists. Thresholds: XBULL the best year, BULL the median, BASE the worst, BEAR one median-to-worst step beyond the worst; whole percent and 10 bp, rounded half up.
